title: Axiom Theory
description: Beneath the source code of reality lie its axioms - and axioms can be distilled, edited and broken. Unlocks the Axiom Distiller.

puzzle.goal: Encode a proof - a sequence of m formulas, formula j being a string of n_j symbols with codes a_jk - as one whole number. Encode each formula as a product of successive primes p_k raised to the symbol codes; then encode the sequence the same way, with successive primes raised to the formulas' own numbers.
puzzle.name: Gödel numbering of a proof (prime-power encoding)
puzzle.form: prod ( j , 1 , m , p _ j ^ prod ( k , 1 , n _ j , p _ k ^ ( a _ ( j * k ) ) ) )
puzzle.ask: Find the number of a single formula of three symbols whose codes are a = 3, b = @{b} and c = 2 (the inner product, with primes 2, 3, 5).

vars.a: symbol code (a_jk; in step 2 the first code)

puzzle.method: Unique prime factorisation makes the encoding reversible: read off exponents to recover each symbol, then each formula.
